# Fleet OPS

> Fleet OPS is compliance and maintenance software for fleet operators managing lorries, trailers, and buses.

## Product

- Track vehicle papers: fitness certificate, insurance, Pollution Under Control (PUC), permit, registration certificate (RC), and road tax.
- View paper status and lead-time reminders, and record document holds and overrides with a reason and responsible person.
- Manage trip records, fuel, driver accounts, maintenance, and tyres.
- Review cost per kilometre and trip accounts; export reports as CSV or PDF and import vehicle data from Excel.
- Role-based views are described for owners, transport in-charges, and accountants.
- Access the product at https://app.fleetops.in/.

## Limits

- Fleet OPS does not provide GPS or live vehicle tracking, driver monitoring, a driver app, bus ticketing, government filing, or a full accounting package.
- Pricing is shared during a product demo; no public price is stated on the website.
